$comment: FIX-1175 — where CC prompts and reports live. Versioned default.
A machine-local override may sit at .claude/cc.config.json and wins over
this file; it is NOT tracked (.gitignore excludes .claude/* except for
agents/, commands/, hooks/ and settings.local.json), which is why the
versioned copy lives here instead. CIVITICS_CC_PROMPTS_DIR and
CIVITICS_CC_REPORTS_DIR override both.
Both paths resolve against the MAIN checkout or the current worktree, not
blindly against the cwd: `git rev-parse --path-format=absolute
--git-common-dir` returns the primary repo's .git from inside a linked
worktree too, so its parent is a stable anchor for a path that points
OUTSIDE the repo. promptsDir uses that anchor; reportsDir is committed and
so uses the current worktree. An absolute path is taken verbatim.
See scripts/lib/cc-config.mjs.
FIX-1242: `lanes` is the closed list a prompt's or report's `lane:` must
name (cc:verify FAILs any other; `design` is a plan-step lane only, never a
report's). `boardDir` is where `pnpm board` writes board.json + index.html;
it is outside the repo, so it anchors on the primary checkout like
promptsDir. CIVITICS_CC_BOARD_DIR overrides it.
FIX-1243: `sectionLanes` places every FIXES.md bullet that carries no
`<!--lane:X-->` marker, by the EXACT text of the `## ` header it sits under.
A marker (written by `fix:add --lane`, or hand-added by Craig) wins over it.
`bugs` is a board-only pseudo-lane — the BUGS section renders as its own
backlog row under the lanes — and is never a valid `lane:` for a prompt,
a report or `fix:add --lane`. A section missing from the map is `unmapped`.
